hooks.command:
python3 -c "
import sys, json
try:
    tool_input = json.load(sys.stdin)
except:
    sys.exit(0)
path = tool_input.get('tool_input', {}).get('file_path', '') or tool_input.get('file_path', '')
if '/data/' in path and path.endswith('.json'):
    print('BLOCK: data/ JSON files are auto-generated by GitHub Actions. Edit config/ files instead.', file=sys.stderr)
    sys.exit(2)
if path.endswith('_config.yml'):
    print('BLOCK: _config.yml is protected. Changes here affect the entire Jekyll build and GitHub Pages deployment. Edit manually only.', file=sys.stderr)
    sys.exit(2)
"
